project: Wuxia Life P74 Renown Pressure Design-First
description: Design-first contract stage for jianghu_renown_sage pressure phase — define the pressure direction, contract, and validation shape before implementation, preserving tavern-born flavor.

userStories.title: Audit renown pressure prerequisites
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a prerequisite audit for the renown pressure stage so P74 starts from the real gating surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize existing renown route flags, markers, events, and expressions (bridge + entry + on-ramp)
Identify what exists before pressure vs what can be reused
Save docs/test-reports/p74-renown-pressure-prerequisite-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Prerequisite audit complete — 3-stage foundation (bridge + entry + on-ramp) verified; 6+ expression surfaces identified; merchant pressure precedent documented; tavern-born flavor consistent.

userStories.title: Lock P74 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P74 stays design-first and does not slip into partial implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P74 to gap audit, direction comparison, pressure contract, and proof shape only
Define allowed layers: documentation, contract, targeted proof planning
List forbidden expansions: runtime wiring, new framework, bulk content wave, payoff design
Save docs/test-reports/p74-renown-pressure-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope contract locked — 4 allowed layers (audit/compare/contract/shape), 12 forbidden expansions, 4 scope guardrails, NO-GO conditions defined.

userStories.title: Compare renown pressure directions
userStories.description: As a designer, I want bounded pressure-direction options so P74 chooses the smallest viable pressure shape before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Compare at least 2 pressure direction candidates (e.g. fame-burden, favor-debt, faction-conflict)
Each candidate includes: core narrative, trigger conditions, player choice space, tavern-born fit
Select recommended direction and document rejected alternatives
Recommendation follows quality-first and small-step principles
Save comparison document
userStories.notes: Pressure direction comparison complete — 3 candidates evaluated; selected: 人情债渐重 (Favor Debt Burden); rejected: 声名之累 (less unique), 江湖恩怨站队 (too generic/high scope); 5/5 flavor fit, 5/5 boundedness, low risk.

userStories.title: Define renown pressure contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit pressure contract so P75 knows exactly what flags, gates, events, and player-facing meanings must be closed.
acceptanceCriteria: Define pressure checkpoint, required flags, and corresponding gate acceptance
Define 1 core pressure event (or 1 tightly coupled event group)
Define at least 2 pressure-specific player-facing signals
Clarify difference between pressure vs on-ramp and vs generic midlife
Preserve tavern-born flavor throughout
Reserve flag interfaces for subsequent payoff stage
Save contract to docs/PRD/p74-renown-pressure-contract.md
userStories.notes: Pressure contract defined — 人情债渐重 direction; renown_midlife_pressure auto event (age 37-41); renown_midlife_pressure_done checkpoint; 2+ core signals (cost label + current goal); 5 expression surfaces; payoff flag interfaces reserved; tavern-born flavor verified.

userStories.title: Define P75 validation shape
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the P75 validation shape fixed in advance so playable pressure work is judged against explicit expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: Define which chain nodes targeted proof must show (on-ramp → pressure → expression changes)
Define which assertions regression tests must cover at minimum
Define what evidence counts as pressure closed
No full lifetime exhaust required
Define regression boundaries for P71/P72/P73 existing evidence
userStories.notes: P75 validation shape defined — ~12 targeted proof chain nodes (5 core), ~14-17 regression assertions across 5 groups, 9 closure criteria, P71/P72/P73 regression boundaries, no full lifetime exhaust required.

userStories.title: Produce P74 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report that locks the renown pressure design-first contract and hands off to P75.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p74-renown-pressure-closure-report.md
Summarize prerequisite audit, scope contract, pressure-direction comparison, pressure contract, validation shape
Clarify boundary with P75
List remaining deferred larger renown-expansion items
State GO / NO-GO for pressure implementation stage
